audience: sales and service teams that keep customer records in 1CRM

useCases.title: Find open deals by value and close date
useCases.text: Read the field names of the opportunities module. Then list the records that match a value and a close date.

useCases.title: Show the contacts of an account
useCases.text: Read one account record by id. Then list the records linked to it, such as its contacts.

useCases.title: Check the connection before a change
useCases.text: Show the 1CRM user the connection signs in as. Then read the fields of a module before you write to it.

useCases.title: Create a lead from a website form
useCases.text: Create one lead record from the field values you pass. The tool changes no existing record.

useCases.title: Update the status of a case
useCases.text: Change the fields you pass on one existing record, such as the status of a case. Only the given fields change.
